retained_obligations: src/x509/v3_ist.rs: `nval` is a live STACK_OF(CONF_VALUE) and every element is NULL or a live CONF_VALUE whose `name` is NUL-terminated (the authority's own strcmp precondition); each member is a live ASN1_UTF8STRING and each `value` operand is NULL or NUL-terminated; `ist_member_guard` reproduces the authority's member/value NULL short-circuit and its ASN1_STRING_set failure answer; every failure arm frees the partially filled item once; `i2r` receives a live item and each non-NULL member's `data` is valid for `length` (BIO_write does not touch it when `length <= 0`); the row's `it` is the owned static ISSUER_SIGN_TOOL descriptor.

src/x509/v3_no_ass.rs and src/x509/v3_no_rev_avail.rs: the four callbacks ignore their value/context arguments; i2r writes nothing and answers 1; r2i/s2i answer the ASN1_NULL sentinel `1`; i2s answers one allocator-seam CRYPTO_strdup block transferred to the caller; each row's item is ASN1_NULL_it.

src/x509/v3_pcia.rs: the exported item groups follow the ASN1_ITEM contract (NULL-or-writable slot, readable cursor and extent for d2i; NULL-or-live value and NULL-or-writable cursor for i2d; NULL-or-live value for free); both descriptors name static templates and the asserted #[repr(C)] sizes/offsets; the inner PROXY_POLICY item is the crate-owned static descriptor.

src/x509/v3_pcons.rs: the exported allocator group follows the ASN1_ITEM contract; `i2v` receives a live POLICY_CONSTRAINTS; `v2i` receives a live CONF_VALUE stack with NUL-terminated non-NULL names; each X509V3_get_value_int failure, an unknown name and the both-fields-NULL empty arm free `pcons` exactly once and answer NULL.

src/x509/v3_pku.rs: the exported item group follows the ASN1_ITEM contract; `i2r` receives a live PKEY_USAGE_PERIOD, each non-NULL member is a live ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME and the prints match the authority's exact literals and separator placement.

src/x509/v3_pmaps.rs: the exported item groups follow the ASN1_ITEM contract; `i2v` receives a live stack of live POLICY_MAPPING entries, both 80-byte buffers are writable and each object is live for i2t_ASN1_OBJECT; `v2i` receives a live CONF_VALUE stack, treats a NULL name-or-value and a failed OBJ_txt2obj as the authority's error arms, frees the current objects and the built list exactly once, and the reserve makes the unchecked push infallible; the pop_free thunk receives NULL or a live POLICY_MAPPING.

src/x509/v3_rolespec.rs: the exported item groups follow the ASN1_ITEM contract; the syntax printer receives a live STACK_OF(OSSL_ROLE_SPEC_CERT_ID) whose elements are live; every element's roleName/roleCertIssuer are live GENERAL_NAMEs, the serial/locator are optional, and each printer refusal arm answers 0 exactly as the authority does.

secret_bearing_buffers: No secret-bearing buffer or cleansing claim changed. Every audited unit handles public certificate configuration and extension data; the only allocations are public strings, ASN.1 values and object stacks, released by the receiving item or extension machinery.
residuals: M86-R1 (info, authority UB not reproduced): when a CONF_VALUE has a NULL name and a non-NULL value, v2i_POLICY_MAPPINGS reaches ERR_raise_data(..., "%s", val->name) in the authority, a NULL argument to %s that is undefined behaviour (glibc renders it as "(null)"). The port's raise_site_data accepts NULL and attaches no data. A valid configuration stack has a non-NULL NUL-terminated name, so the arm is unreachable from a valid config and the difference is never a memory-safety one.
